title: Zero Trust Exchange for B2B: site-to-site, partner and B2C access to private applications

prose.text: {{b2b-use-cases}} The ZPA federation feature with a similar name is in [[zpa.b2b-federation]].

Whether B2B handles identity and trust across organizations, and not only across segments of one organization, is open {{gap:b2b-cross-org}}. Whether it has an SDK distinct from ZPA is open {{gap:b2b-sdk}}.

checks.do: For a question about partner or B2C access, check whether the scenario is site-to-site, partner portal or mobile before answering from the use-case claim.

b2b-what.statement: Zscaler B2B is a cloud service that gives business customers secure and fast access to B2B applications, through site-to-site ZTNA connectivity, partner portal access and B2C mobile app access.

quotes: business customers secure and fast access to B2B applications
Site-to-site B2B connectivity via zero trust network access (ZTNA)
Partner portal access with browser-based application delivery
B2C mobile app access for consumer-facing applications

b2b-vs-zpa.statement: Standard ZPA is user-to-application access (north-south, single-org); B2B gives external parties secure access to private B2B applications without network exposure.

quotes: gives **external parties** secure access to private B2B apps without network exposure

b2b-no-inbound.statement: The page says B2B eliminates complex VPNs and that applications need no inbound DMZs or open ports.

quotes: without inbound DMZs or open ports

b2b-inspection.statement: The page cites full TLS/SSL inspection at scale with identity- and context-aware policies.

quotes: Full TLS/SSL inspection at scale with identity- and context-aware policies

b2b-use-cases.statement: The listed primary use cases are partner or supplier site-to-site VPN replacement, third-party contractor application access, B2B customer portal delivery, server-to-server connectivity over the internet, and mobile application access for B2C customers.

quotes: Mobile application access for B2C customers

b2b-cross-org.title: Whether B2B handles cross-organization identity and trust
b2b-cross-org.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Distinguishing detail vs base ZPA: B2B handles cross-organization identity and trust, not just cross-segment-within-one-org.' The B2B capture describes identity- and context-aware access for external parties but does not describe cross-organization trust.

b2b-sdk.title: Whether Zscaler B2B has an SDK surface distinct from ZPA
b2b-sdk.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'No SDK distinct from ZPA's; configured via the broader ZPA admin surfaces.' The B2B capture names no API or SDK surface.
